direction.name: 제품 구조의 그래픽 도해
direction.concept: Create an architectural graphic explanation of shade, supports and light on paper with the intact product incorporated into the line/plane system. Line drawing and precise full-product photograph join at meaningful real parts; no invented internal mechanics or dimensions.
direction.image_grammar: Sharp drafted outlines, controlled large-scale light footprints and carefully joined product/photo detail boundaries. Diagram is about visible structure and illumination, not unsupported specs or numbered fake labels.
direction.body_flow: Visible horizontal shade and the light footprint organise a stepped yet aligned reading path. Connect the main explanation paragraph to that footprint, then the nearby event/date/place group and contiguous visit details/URL. All copy roles find the next group through shared baselines or a real image boundary. Do not scatter unrelated annotations around each part.
direction.type: Refined compact Korean/Latin sans of stable proportions with readable counters and measured medium weight. Body and practical group use consistent system; numeric/date emphasis is restrained relative to the explanation. No fake tiny technical printing.
direction.distinctness: Precise lines, functional visible-product relationships and stepped alignments, instead of film-like montage, painted scenic depth or print hatching.

common_constraints: Prioritize the new skill first-generation body-copy design. Print copy once in a compact positive tool brief, no rubric or whole plan dump.
User product identity and literal copy are authoritative; case-specific direction is implementation guidance, not invented user-fixed coordinates/font/grid.
Every role views its own actual study originals before designing. Study material is not a client asset and is not automatically passed to native generation.
The Canva whole sample is a negative default-template example: take grouping/proximity only, do not repeat its title/date/panel scaffold.
Never read peer makers or quality feedback. Select/close own result before independent evaluation.

assets.kind: synthetic product photograph-style fixture, not real client photograph or a poster

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
